verdict.rationale: W&B ships a first-party MCP server and Skills that let assistants answer natural-language questions about Weave traces, evaluations and runs. Marketing claims coding agents like Claude Code can use them to run evaluations and iteration loops. Natural-language operation therefore works only through an external AI client: no native in-product natural-language command interface is documented, and the operational claims come from marketing pages. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command interface, documented scope of natural-language actions beyond querying data (e.g. creating or modifying evals, alerts and settings), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: connects AI assistants to your Weights & Biases data and documentation so they can answer natural-language questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave. They can read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own
install Skills so that the agent can work with experiment tracking, tracing, evaluations, and monitoring on its own
